sources:
Statewide layer: every RI city and town, three official numbers side by side.

  census    Census Building Permits Survey, units authorized, 2000-2025 (raw/bps/)
  doh_2024  RI Dept of Housing municipal permit survey + completions estimate, 2024
            (2024 Integrated Housing Report, Figures 2.1 and 2.3; raw/doh/2024.txt)
  goal      Housing 2030 five-year permitting goal, 2026-2030 (housing.ri.gov/media/3401)

Writes data/statewide.json and data/census-permits-ri.csv.
